correctness.rationale: For independent exponential agent costs normalize to independent uniform simplex Dirichlet(1) vectors. Each subset-half sign h_S determines EF allocation, and complement S^c reverses sign; success iff sign chambers differ, so failure=sum p_H². In four chores, tetrahedral pair-coordinate map has volume 8/3. Each vertex octant mass 3/16, other octants 1/16; singleton-dominance subregion mass 1/8 apiece; eight residual chambers mass 1/16. Four (1/8) and eight (1/16) give success 29/32. Independently checked exact geometry, rational lattice chamber counts converging with grid refinement, and m=2,3 trivial half simplex cases. Domain m<=4 only.
